If the INPUT transform on the field is defined, execute it. If the DDER flag is not set and the SPECIAL LOOKUP code is defined, execute it. If no DB(DQ) entry exists, display a blank node and the current value of the field. Branch to label V.
8519a979: Kill the DDER flag and branch to label X.

20476554: If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the Uppercase Null device and DIC(0) based on the existence of DB(DQ) and whether DV contains '''. If DLAYGO is provided, set it. e4f4e0d2: If DV doesn't contain 'N' and the number portion of X exceeds 24 digits, kill X and branch to label Z.
508c2df7: If the INPUT transform in the COMPUTED FIELD multiple doesn't start with '$', X is numeric with a leading '-' and DQ(DQ) has the string '+X'=X', convert X to numeric.
